    //==
    // # Interface obligations of the indexed surface meshes
    //
    // The concrete bodies that make TriangleMesh3D, TriangleMesh2D and QuadMesh3D
    // (`meshes.types.plato`) honor their declared interfaces: the IMeshElementCounts census
    // for all three, ITriangulatedGeometry3D random access for TriangleMesh3D,
    // IMesh2D for TriangleMesh2D, and IMesh3D for QuadMesh3D. Undirected
    // edge counts dedupe through the first-occurrence rule stated with the face
    // arrays below, so they hold for open meshes as well as closed ones.

    //==
    // # TriangleMesh3D

    // The number of positions the faces index into.
    VertexCount(self: TriangleMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Positions.Count;

    // The number of triangle faces.
    FaceCount(self: TriangleMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.Count;

    // The number of deduplicated undirected edges. Quadratic census; see
    // the face-array section below - UndirectedEdgeCount.
    UndirectedEdgeCount(self: TriangleMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.DirectedEdges.UndirectedEdgeCount;

    // The ITriangulatedGeometry3D obligation: every face is a triangle.
    TriangleCount(self: TriangleMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.Count;

    // The face record at a typed face index. Precondition: the index is
    // present and within [0, FaceCount).
    FaceAt(self: TriangleMesh3D, face: FaceIndex): TriangleFace
        => self.Faces[face.Value];

    // The position a typed vertex index refers to. Precondition: the index is
    // present and within [0, VertexCount).
    PositionAt(self: TriangleMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): Point3D
        => self.Positions[vertex.Value];

    // The IMesh3D obligation (inherited through ITriangulatedGeometry3D):
    // an indexed triangle mesh is its own triangulation.
    ToTriangleMesh(self: TriangleMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D
        => self;

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, faces unchanged.
    Deform(self: TriangleMesh3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): TriangleMesh3D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Faces);

    // The IIndexedGeometry obligations: the shared pool and the index table.
    Vertices(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<Point3D>
        => self.Positions;

    FaceIndices(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<TriangleFace>
        => self.Faces;

    // The IPrimitiveGeometry obligation: each face gathered into a concrete
    // triangle. Precondition (IIndexedGeometry): every index is in range.
    Primitives(self: TriangleMesh3D): Array<Triangle3D>
        => self.Faces.Map(f => Triangle3D(self.Positions[f.A.Value],
                                          self.Positions[f.B.Value],
                                          self.Positions[f.C.Value]));

    //==
    // # TriangleMesh2D

    // The number of positions the faces index into.
    VertexCount(self: TriangleMesh2D): Integer
        => self.Positions.Count;

    // The number of triangle faces.
    FaceCount(self: TriangleMesh2D): Integer
        => self.Faces.Count;

    // The number of deduplicated undirected edges. Quadratic census; see
    // the face-array section below - UndirectedEdgeCount.
    UndirectedEdgeCount(self: TriangleMesh2D): Integer
        => self.Faces.DirectedEdges.UndirectedEdgeCount;

    // The IMesh2D obligation: a planar triangle mesh is its own
    // triangulation.
    Triangulate(self: TriangleMesh2D): TriangleMesh2D
        => self;

    // The IDeformable2D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, faces unchanged.
    Deform(self: TriangleMesh2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): TriangleMesh2D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Faces);

    // The IIndexedGeometry obligations: the shared pool and the index table.
    Vertices(self: TriangleMesh2D): Array<Point2D>
        => self.Positions;

    FaceIndices(self: TriangleMesh2D): Array<TriangleFace>
        => self.Faces;

    // The IPrimitiveGeometry obligation: each face gathered into a concrete
    // planar triangle.
    Primitives(self: TriangleMesh2D): Array<Triangle2D>
        => self.Faces.Map(f => Triangle2D(self.Positions[f.A.Value],
                                          self.Positions[f.B.Value],
                                          self.Positions[f.C.Value]));

    //==
    // # QuadMesh3D

    // The number of positions the faces index into.
    VertexCount(self: QuadMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Positions.Count;

    // The number of quad faces.
    FaceCount(self: QuadMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.Count;

    // The number of deduplicated undirected edges. Quadratic census; see
    // the face-array section below - UndirectedEdgeCount.
    UndirectedEdgeCount(self: QuadMesh3D): Integer
        => self.Faces.DirectedEdges.UndirectedEdgeCount;

    // The IMesh3D obligation: two triangles per quad over the shared
    // positions, split on the A-C diagonal (the fan from corner 0).
    ToTriangleMesh(self: QuadMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D
        => (self.Positions, self.Faces.FlatMap(q => q.FanTriangles));

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, faces unchanged.
    Deform(self: QuadMesh3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): QuadMesh3D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Faces);

    // The IIndexedGeometry obligations: the shared pool and the index table.
    Vertices(self: QuadMesh3D): Array<Point3D>
        => self.Positions;

    FaceIndices(self: QuadMesh3D): Array<QuadFace>
        => self.Faces;

    // The IPrimitiveGeometry obligation: each face gathered into a concrete
    // quad. Coplanarity is not guaranteed; see QuadFace.
    Primitives(self: QuadMesh3D): Array<Quad3D>
        => self.Faces.Map(f => Quad3D(self.Positions[f.A.Value],
                                      self.Positions[f.B.Value],
                                      self.Positions[f.C.Value],
                                      self.Positions[f.D.Value]));
